meta.name: build
meta.description: Implement a scoped customer-facing software change in the existing repository and verify its behavior. Use for delivery work with an understood outcome, not incident response.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在现有代码库里完成范围明确的软件改动,并验证它是否正确运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需求已经明确,要把改动落到现有代码库并确认行为正确。
copy.tagline_en: Implement a scoped software change in an existing repo and verify it works
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a change is well-scoped and you want it built into the codebase and verified.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会在你现有的代码仓库里实现一处范围明确的、面向客户的软件改动，并验证它的行为。动手前它先读任务上下文契约和方法文档，再按你仓库的说明与可用工具开展工作。
howto.when: 当你要做的是结果已知的交付类改动——在现有仓库中实现并验证一处改动时接管；线上事故响应不在它范围内。

say.text: 在这个仓库里实现这个改动，并验证它的行为。
say.note: 它会先读任务上下文契约再动手。

say.text: 按我们仓库的说明改这个功能，别扩大范围。
say.note: 范围限定在已提供的上下文内。

say.text: 帮我确认这处改动真的按预期跑通了。
say.note: 它会做验证，没跑的检查会如实说明。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude implements a scoped customer-facing software change in your existing repository and verifies its behavior. It first reads the task context contract and the method, then works from the supplied context and your repo instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggers for delivery work with an understood outcome: implementing and verifying a scoped change in an existing repository. Not for incident response.

say_en.text: Implement this change in the repo and verify its behavior.
say_en.note: It reads the task context contract first.

say_en.text: Change this feature per our repo instructions; keep the scope tight.
say_en.note: Scope stays within the supplied context.

say_en.text: Confirm this change actually behaves as expected.
say_en.note: It runs checks and reports any it didn't run.
